VBO:0200598.summary: Alert and devoted to its people, the Mittel German Spitz often combines a buoyant manner with an independent streak. Its medium size was once the familiar working Spitz of artisans, peasants and wagoners, valued for loyalty and guarding. It also left a lively cultural trail in paintings, magazines and poetry, well before formal recognition by the German breed club in 1969.
VBO:0200598.shortDescription: A buoyant, independent companion, the Mittel German Spitz carries the watchful heritage of a small working guardian.

sources.title: Royal Kennel Club: German Spitz (Mittel) standard
sources.evidence: Characteristics intelligent/active/alert with buoyancy, independence and family devotion; temperament happy/equable/confident. Small erect triangular ears, wedge head, square body, straight harsh doublecoat/frill, high full tail curled from root over back. UK Klein23–29cm and Mittel30–38cm, all colours except merle.

sources.title: Royal Kennel Club: German Spitz (Mittel)
sources.evidence: About this breed explicitly names larger Mittel and smaller Klein, same standard divided only by size and most colours/combinations permitted. These are colour-unrestricted size categories, not aliases of one already published colour-scoped record.
